title: IWORD: honor Original Document Backup before replacing a saved version
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1172-1185 persists setting byte 6, but write_file at :1236-1263 never consumes it; :1045 only displays it. Ground truth: pubs/manuals/initechword-reference/ref-s.tex:308-315 admits the inert setting; WP Reference Backup Options pp. 42-43 and the existing Yes preference define the recovery intent. The admission is not deliberate canon. Scope: Keep the preceding successfully saved document as a recoverable original when Yes is selected. Coordinate with initech-mcep for atomic replacement; do not reimplement or refile its failed-save rollback. Capture real WP backup naming/rotation before choosing bytes or names. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend harness/proptest/test_iword_face.c with Yes/No, second/third save, backup-name collision and disk-full/close/rename fault cases. Extract original and new versions with mtools and read both independently/with real WP. Mutant: ignore byte 6. Replay S01 backup keys and require a record-flair clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-backup-yes.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/s01-directory.txt.

title: IWORD: reject invalid filename spaces without silently changing the destination
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1725 accepts only ch > space, so take_name at :1202 never sees spaces and can approve a different name. Ground truth: pubs/manuals/initechword-reference/ref-f.tex:16-37 specifies the allowed characters and an Invalid file name refusal. Scope: Retain invalid input for validation or visibly refuse it at input; never silently turn BAD NAME.WP5 into BADNAME.WP5. Apply to Save and Retrieve, including offered-name replacement. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test-iword-face with leading/internal/trailing spaces, legal names, backspace correction and existing-destination sentinels. Emulator Save/Retrieve must show the refusal and preserve disk hashes. Mutant: restore the ch > space filter. Record the trace/clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-space-name.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/s01-extracted/BADNAME.WP5.

title: IWORD: keep status and modal prompts reachable after window resize
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:186-206 fixes 76x24 cells and status/pane rows; :843 and :2412 repaint these constants after resize without reading content geometry. Ground truth: PRD 6.3, ADR-0013 native document windows, and the audited grow-control workflow; exact compact layout is an authored native adaptation, not a claimed WP DOS screen. Scope: Use actual content bounds for viewport, status, menus and Reveal layout, or enforce a truthful supported minimum size. A grow operation must not hide the only Save/error/cancel prompt. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test-iword-face geometry mock and test-flair-iword with shrink/grow during editing, Save, error, Setup and Reveal; assert prompt pixels remain visible and cancel preserves bytes. Mutant: retain LINE_STATUS=23 at the small size. Locked QEMU/Bochs trace plus record-flair clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-resize.png.

title: FLAIR/IWORD: deliver Finder power requests to Word Exit and expose the save decision
description: Root: os/flair/tbxgate.c:1550 recognizes only an enabled item literally named Quit; os/iword/app/face_a.c:244 names it Exit. os/milton/kmain.c:5715-5723 cancels on -1 with serial-only cannot-ask. Ground truth: Inside Macintosh VI Quit Application semantics cited at os/milton/kmain.c:5691-5705; Word request_exit at os/iword/app/face_a.c:1703-1707 is the existing save guard. Scope: Represent the quit action independently of its localized/period label and bring Word forward for a usable save/cancel interaction. Preserve dirty text on refusal and visibly explain a tenant that cannot answer. initech-cqej covers decline/Bochs test debt, not this Exit-versus-Quit dispatch defect. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend the Toolbox quit-route host oracle with Exit, Quit, absent and disabled actions. Drive Word dirty/clean/save/no/cancel/failed-save through Finder Restart and Shut Down; require responsive prompts, preserved bytes on cancel and QEMU/Bochs agreement. Mutant: require literal Quit. Record the clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-before-shutdown.png.

title: Toolbox/IWORD: detect or eliminate silent directory enumeration truncation
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1369 and :1412 request only 256 records. os/flair/tbxgate.c:1078-1092 keeps walking but stops copying/counting at capacity and returns success; os/iword/core/listfiles.c:143 then removes dot entries, leaving 254 files. Ground truth: pubs/manuals/initechword-reference/ref-l.tex:73-99 promises file listing/count/used size; prepare_stress.py and stress-before-directory.txt independently establish 270 files and 92340 bytes. Scope: Make overflow explicit in the gate contract and app, with continuation/paging or an honest visible partial-list warning. Do not fix this by only increasing LF_MAX: root directories, subdirectories and counts must have a defined capacity contract. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Add gate and test_iword_listfiles.c cases for 254/255/256/270+ files, dot entries and subdirectories. Emulator must reach F269 or visibly disclose the limit and partial totals; compare against mdir. Mutant: suppress overflow/continuation. Lock the trace and record-flair clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-many-first.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/stress-before-directory.txt.

title: IWORD Look: restore cancellation, text scrolling and adjacent-document navigation
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1502-1517 omits F1 and Next/Prev handlers and gates motion on g_look_wp; :1614 resets plain-text rendering to byte zero every paint. Ground truth: pubs/manuals/initechword-reference/ref-c.tex:12-15 (Cancel), WP Reference Look printed p. 363/PDF pp. 381-384, and spec/iword/listfiles.h:137 (Look menu). Scope: Use one read-only Look viewport with WP/text scroll state and real Next/Prev document selection. F1 must cancel without editing the active document. Keep directory selection and current unsaved document intact; define missing/read-error and end-of-list behavior from a real WP mint. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend harness/proptest/test_iword_face.c and test_iword_listfiles.c with 80-line text, WP files, F1/Esc/F7/Space and Next/Prev boundaries. Emulator must reach text line 080 and another named file, then restore the unchanged editing document. Mutants: force text offset zero, omit F1, ignore Next. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-look-cancel-f1.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-look-text-top.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/stress-fixtures/TEXTLONG.TXT; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-look-long-before-next.png.

title: IWORD Search: translate Ctrl-M from the actual FLAIR key event
description: Root: os/flair/event.c:539-547 supplies printable m plus Control; os/iword/app/face_a.c:2311 accepts printable text before :2313 tests ch==13 for Ctrl-M, so that existing SRt branch is unreachable for the real chord. Ground truth: WP Reference printed p. 573 (PDF p. 591), independently re-extracted: Ctrl-m includes SRt. The audit evidence/references/wp-search.txt excerpt is from earlier pages and does not contain this instruction. Scope: Recognize the Control modifier plus M virtual/character key before printable query insertion; insert one 0x0D search token. Keep Ctrl-Enter hard-page and ordinary Enter hard-return behavior distinct. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test_iword_p3.c/search tests using the exact 0x326D+Control event, then replay target Ctrl-M search across a wrapped line in both directions. Assert query bytes/label and found range. Mutant: require ch==13 again. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-search-srt-query.png.

title: IWORD: distinguish zero margins from invalid numeric input
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1849-1863 returns zero for both valid 0 and invalid input; :1924 updates the margin only when v is nonzero. os/iword/core/edit.c:1271 permits zero with valid remaining width. Ground truth: pubs/manuals/initechword-reference/ref-m.tex:64-66 accepts readable margins below 9 inches; the core range contract accepts zero. Scope: Return parse success separately from the value. Apply zero when valid; keep blank/default/cancel separate and visibly refuse values that violate paper width. Preserve existing document/cursor on refusal. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): test-iword-face plus core tests for 0, 0.00, blank, malformed, valid fractions and impossible left+right combinations; decode D0/01 values independently after emulator Save. Mutant: use if(v). Record format trace/clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-zero-margins.png.

title: IWORD: consume the selected entry and status measurement units
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1172-1185 stores unit bytes 4/5, but status :733/:745, format :926 and parse_inches :1849 always use inches; no unit consumer exists outside the Setup labels. Ground truth: spec/iword/settings.h:5-8 defines independent entry/status unit preferences; WP Reference Units of Measure pp. 698-700; ref-s.tex:360-362 documents the incomplete consumers. Scope: Implement both preference consumers with explicit units and round-trip conversion for i/c/p/w/u. Keep canonical stored WP coordinates in WPU and settings bytes unchanged; do not merely rename inch values. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test_iword_p3_part2.c and test-iword-face with independent rational conversion fixtures and differing entry/status settings; emulator save/relaunch, margins and Pos/Ln must use the chosen units. Mutant: force inches at one consumer. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-units-cm.png.

title: IWORD: support the verified soft-page code variants in real multipage WP5 files
description: Root: os/iword/core/piece.c:245-258 admits neither 0x8C nor 0x0B as a single unit; os/iword/fs/wp5.c:54-56 rejects the file. Read-only byte inspection finds MINT39 first rejected at 0x23E (0x8C), MINT44 at 0x2BB (0x0B). Ground truth: ../wordperfect51-decomp/mint/wpMINT39.steps and wpMINT44.steps, their real saved files/captures, and the audit independent decoder. Existing locked single-code data predates these mints. Scope: Add independently verified HRt-SPg and SRt-SPg semantics to unit scanning, paging, display, editing and serialization. Record the locked-spec update. Keep refusal for unknown/malformed codes. initech-tu3d covers prefix packets/D4 research, not the missing single-byte dispatch. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test-iword-core and test-iword-wp5-roundtrip with MINT39/44 and mutation-proven soft-page type/round-trip checks. Emulator must retrieve, navigate pages, Save and reopen in real WP with text/paragraphs preserved. Mutant: reject or flatten one soft-page variant. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-import-mint39.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/fixtures/MINT39.WP5.

title: IWORD: implement inline Center and Flush Right codes and their entry commands
description: Root: os/iword/core/piece.c:299 recognizes only C1/02 as positioned content; C1/E0 and C1/60 fall back to zero-width IW_U_CODE. os/iword/core/edit.c:388-421 handles paragraph Justification only. spec/iword/fkeys.h:47/:61 gray the two insertion commands. Ground truth: ../wordperfect51-decomp/goldens/minted/MINT01.shots/02_typed.png and MINT03.shots/02_typed.png; spec/iword/wp5_format.h and codes.c:343-344 identify the inline codes. ref-c.tex:118-124 acknowledges left-margin fallback. Scope: Share the inline alignment layout model between imports and Shift-F6/Alt-F6 insertion, including end-of-alignment 0x83, wrapping, cursor and Reveal. Preserve the existing separate Format Justification implementation. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test-iword-face/codes/WP5 differential against real MINT01/03 positions and newly minted command traces; verify display coordinates and round-trip bytes. Mutants: treat C1/E0 or C1/60 as zero-width formatting only. Record emulator clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-real-mint01.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/fixtures/MINT01.WP5; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-import-mint03.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/fixtures/MINT03.WP5; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-key-center.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-key-flush-right.png.

title: IWORD: add page navigation and a real Go To prompt
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1952-1989 has no PgUp/PgDn or Ctrl-Home dispatch; :2108-2116 falls back to ordinary cursor/typing and never enters a Go To mode. Ground truth: WP Reference Cursor Movement p. 104 and Go To p. 224, cited in audit evidence/references/wp-cursor.txt and wp-goto.txt; confirm exact page behavior against the original manual/mint. Scope: Use the document page model to reach next/previous page and parse Ctrl-Home page numbers. No navigation prefix or its digits may enter document text; cancellation preserves cursor/document. Coordinate soft-page support with B10. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test-iword-face/core with hard/soft/mixed pages, first/last boundaries, invalid page and Go To cancel. Emulator long-document trace must assert page/cursor and unchanged saved bytes. Mutants: ignore PgDn or route Go To digits to typing. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-long-open.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-goto-six.png.

title: IWORD: share word boundaries for Ctrl-arrow movement and Delete Word
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1984-1985 ignores modifiers in cursor_key; :2108 always invokes ED_DELETE for Delete, with no word-operation route. Ground truth: WP Reference pp. 104 (Word Right) and 116 (Ctrl-Del); ref-c.tex cursor limits and ref-d.tex:57-59 admit the reduced routes. Scope: Implement modifier-aware word movement/deletion over complete document units. Establish punctuation, whitespace, attributes and hard-return boundaries from real WP, then share the boundary walker and existing undo machinery. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host table-driven real-WP boundary corpus plus test-iword-face exact modifier events; emulator one two three and coded-word controls must move/delete whole words and undo accurately. Mutant: use one-unit movement/deletion. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-ctrl-right.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-delete-word.png.

title: IWORD: add confirmed delete-to-line and delete-to-page commands
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1986 routes End to navigation regardless of Control; :2107-2110 has no Ctrl-End/Ctrl-PgDn deletion or page confirmation state. Ground truth: WP Reference Delete p. 116: Ctrl-End deletion and Ctrl-PgDn then Y, independently checked against the original manual before locking edge transcripts. Scope: Connect deletion extents to the shared layout/complete-unit and undo contracts. Page deletion must wait for the real confirmation; No/F1/EOF-style input failure preserves bytes. Do not silently turn End navigation itself into deletion. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host line/page boundary cases with codes, soft wraps and empty final pages; emulator confirmed/cancelled delete plus Undelete and extracted WP bytes. Mutants: navigation-only Ctrl-End and unconditional page delete. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-delete-end-line.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s05-delete-page-at-start.png.

title: IWORD: connect document hit testing and scrollbars to its viewport
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:2412-2438 has no content mouse/scroll case or viewport-control registration. os/milton/kmain.c:2310-2315 ignores a bar with no active scroll controller. Ground truth: WP Reference Mouse Support and PRD 6.3/ADR-0013 native document interaction. Scrollbar movement is a native adaptation; the shot shows gray arrows, not proof of an enabled controller. Scope: Expose needed Toolbox events/state and map clicks/scroll steps through actual resized viewport, formatting and Reveal geometry. A click must place the cursor at the clicked unit; active scrollbar state must track document extent. Coordinate geometry B03. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host point-to-unit/viewport boundary oracle independent of the renderer; emulator click line 1 while cursor is on line 23, then arrow/page/thumb scrolling, resize and Reveal. Mutants: ignore content mouseDown or leave scroll state unregistered. QEMU/Bochs and record-flair clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-home-down.png.

title: IWORD: implement Insert/typeover as an editor mode
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:2100-2116 contains only insert typing; VK Insert has no handler and the app keeps no typeover state. Ground truth: pubs/manuals/initechword-reference/ref-i.tex:73-74 admits Ins is inert; lock the WP 5.1 Insert/typeover rules from the original reference and a real mint before implementing code boundaries. Scope: Toggle insert/typeover, show its state and replace the appropriate next text unit without splitting formatting codes. Preserve documented end-of-line/end-of-file and undo behavior. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend core/face host tests with insertion/typeover toggles, codes, returns and EOF; emulator Insert Z over existing text then undo/retrieve. Mutant: always insert. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-typeover.png.

title: IWORD: implement Repeat Value and Home-Space prefix actions
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:2369-2370 retains only a Home count, and :2115 types Space normally; Esc enters no repeat-count state. The existing Home prefix is consumed without a Space action. Ground truth: WP Reference Cursor Movement p. 105 (Repeat Value); ../wordperfect51-decomp/mint/wpMINT05.steps and specs/file-formats/wp5-body-codes.md section 2 verify Home-Space emits A0. Scope: Add bounded explicit prefix states so counts do not become document text and Home-Space inserts one hard-space unit. Capture repeat scope, cancellation and overflow rules from real WP; reuse existing hard-space layout support. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host prefix state tables and exact key events; emulator Esc 3 Right moves three units without inserting 3, Home-Space Save decodes A0 and prevents a wrap there. Mutants: type count digits or emit 0x20. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-repeat-value.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-hardspace-compose.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/s03-extracted/CHARS.WP5.

title: IWORD Block: connect paragraph extension and code-aware Search
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:2000-2019 block_key handles arrows/attributes/move/delete but omits Enter and F2/Shift-F2. Paragraph selection and search exist at other entry points, not this one. Ground truth: WP Reference Block pp. 49-50 and Search p. 573; original manual extraction confirms Enter extends to HRt and Search expands/contracts an active block. Scope: Retain the anchor while Enter extends to paragraph end and Search moves the selected endpoint. Match forward/backward, cancellation and not-found behavior without running replacement over a stale block. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test-iword-face and test_iword_p3.c with forward/reverse block, next HRt, code boundaries and successful/failed/cancelled searches. Emulator checks highlight and saved bytes before/after action. Mutants: drop Enter or clear the anchor on Search. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-block-enter-at-start.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-block-search.png.

title: IWORD Block: save the selected stream as an independent WP5 file
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:2000-2019 returns from block_key without dispatching F10; the Save route at :2070 is reachable only without an active block. Ground truth: WP Reference Block pp. 49-51; ref-b.tex:50-60 acknowledges the limited block commands; WP5 prefix/unit contracts in spec/iword/wp5_format.h. Scope: Use the existing self-contained block stream with a valid independent prefix; do not compact/adopt the entire editing document as though it was saved. Integrate safe new/replace writes through initech-mcep. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host selected text/attribute/return cases and independent WP5 decoding; emulator Block Save, cancel, overwrite No and failed save must preserve source and previous destination, while real WP opens only the selected output. Mutant: save entire document. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-block-save.png.

title: IWORD Switch: add secondary-document switching and block case conversion
description: Root: spec/iword/fkeys.h:44 maps Switch to gray; os/iword/app/face_a.c:2013/:2019 provides no block Shift-F3 route and stores just one global document/editor. Ground truth: WP Reference p. 57 for block Uppercase/Lowercase; docs/plans/INITECH-WORD-plan.md:173 names Doc 1/Doc 2 Switch as SHOULD, and spec/iword/fkeys.json:22 locks the key. Scope: Implement the context-sensitive Switch command: case conversion for a block, otherwise independently retained document contexts. Start with the case-conversion slice and retain secondary-document work on this same owner until complete; no one-window app or Face B claim closes it. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host mixed-case/code-aware selected streams and two dirty contexts with separate cursor/undo/name state; emulator switch/save/cancel/exit both documents and block-case controls. Mutants: ignore Shift-F3 or share one document state. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-block-case.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-key-switch.png.

title: IWORD: add timed document recovery through the save lifecycle
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1044 draws Timed Backup gray and setup_key :1167-1171 handles only Original Backup; :2412 has no timed recovery consumer. Ground truth: WP Reference Backup Options pp. 42-43 and ref-s.tex:308-310; exact interval, recovery-file naming and recovery prompt require a real WP reference/mint. Scope: Add an injectable cooperative timer and a recoverable backup stream, without clearing the dirty flag or overwriting the saved document. Coordinate the atomic file mechanism on initech-mcep; original-version rotation remains B01. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host fixed-clock trigger/reset and write/close/no-space failures; emulator edit/wait/relaunch/recover with extracted original/recovery bytes. Mutants: skip timer or mark dirty document clean after backup. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s03-timed-backup.png.

title: IWORD List Files: implement typed, default and Other Directory paths
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1488-1491 accepts only Enter/cancel and always opens root; :1521-1532 has no key 7 action. :1347-1350 explicitly says typing and = are ignored despite the drawn hint. Ground truth: WP Reference List Files PDF pp. 364-370; ../wordperfect51-decomp/mint/work/LISTF/mint-results-005.md; spec/iword/listfiles.h path/default hint and Other Directory choice. Scope: Use one validated directory/default resolver for F5 input, = and Other Directory. Retain current document/list selection on bad path/cancel and respect the actual supported mounted-drive contract. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host path/default persistence/navigation cases; emulator F5 APPS, = default directory, key 7, parent/root, missing directory and cancel. Mutant: force root after every prompt. Compare mdir and record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-list-path-typing.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s01-list-default-dir.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s05-list-file-selected.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/s05-file-ops.json.

title: IWORD List Files: add safe Delete, Move/Rename and Copy operations
description: Root: spec/iword/listfiles.h:116-122 sets keys 2/3/8 live=0; os/iword/app/face_a.c:1521-1532 dispatches only Retrieve/Look/directory motion. Ground truth: WP Reference List Files PDF pp. 364-370; spec/iword/listfiles.h menu records; ref-l.tex:103-107 admits these disabled operations. Scope: Build a shared selected-file operation adapter with confirmation, collision/read-only/no-space feedback and refreshed listing. Keep source and destination safe; use existing Toolbox file verbs and the atomic mechanism on initech-mcep rather than a second truncate/copy loop. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Mock file-operation host tests plus emulator disposable fixtures: cancel/confirm Delete, rename collision and copy success/failure, protected files and directory selection. Compare mtools hashes/FAT and unchanged active document. Mutants: wrong selected path, skip protection or truncate destination before copy. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s05-list-file-selected.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/s05-file-ops.json.

title: IWORD List Files: add Short/Long Display mode
description: Root: spec/iword/listfiles.h:118 sets key 5 inactive; os/iword/app/face_a.c:1521-1532 has no display-mode state or dispatch. Ground truth: WP Reference List Files PDF pp. 364-370 and the real LISTF mint; ref-l.tex:103-107 acknowledges the missing mode. Scope: Implement the independently captured short/long listing layouts with selection and viewport preservation; adapt the real screen to native bounds explicitly. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test_iword_listfiles.c with independent row goldens and selection mapping; emulator toggle at a scrolled list and retrieve the same selected file. Mutant: keep one layout or shift the selected identity. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s05-list-file-selected.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/s05-file-ops.json.

title: IWORD List Files: implement Find and Name Search over the directory model
description: Root: spec/iword/listfiles.h:121-122 sets keys 9/N inactive; os/iword/app/face_a.c:1521-1532 never enters either query state. Ground truth: WP Reference List Files PDF pp. 364-370 and a real WP mint for each distinct Find/Name Search rule; do not infer the two operations from their labels alone. Scope: Add distinct validated queries, results/no-match feedback and cancellation over a complete/explicitly limited listing (B05). Preserve selected identity, current directory and dirty editing document. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Host independently minted query/match/order fixtures; emulator positive/no-match/cancel cases, with a match after record 254 and both keys. Mutants: match all files or search only the first display page. Record clip. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/shots/s05-list-file-selected.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-iword/evidence/s05-file-ops.json.

title: IWORD Setup: add the Display submenu and one verified display consumer
description: Root: os/iword/app/face_a.c:1030 draws Display gray; :1167 accepts only Setup choice 3, so no Display state exists. Ground truth: WP Reference Setup/Display and ref-s.tex:295-297; original WP reference and real capture must define each supported display setting. Scope: First pickup: capture the real Display menu and implement one useful native display option end-to-end, including persistence and cancellation. Track remaining options on this feature; merely opening a menu does not finish it. Acceptance oracle (required, not run): Extend test_iword_p3_part2.c and test-iword-face with real independent menu/value goldens, changed renderer behavior and reload.
